title: Levels of Proficiency of Seniors who Have Gone Through Seniors Go Digital Programme
what_it_is: Levels of Proficiency of Seniors who Have Gone Through Seniors Go Digital Programme

sections.label: Seniors Go Digital training
sections.summary: Under the Seniors Go Digital programme, Digital Ambassadors have engaged and trained over 190,000 seniors to date.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Under the Seniors Go Digital (SGD) programme, SDO's Digital Ambassadors (DAs) have engaged and trained over 190,000 seniors to date.

sections.label: Seniors digital skills survey
sections.summary: A 2021 survey found about nine in 10 seniors kept applying learnt digital skills, and CSA's SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme engaged over 45,000 seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In a 2021 survey with seniors conducted one month after their engagement with the SDO, about nine in 10 seniors said they continued to apply the digital skills they learnt in their daily lives.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: For instance, the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA) has a SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme that raises awareness and drives adoption of cyber hygiene practices amongst seniors, and has engaged more than 45,000 seniors since its launch.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: With online scams being a growing threat, a range of topics and tips for seniors to guard against online scams have been included.

sections.label: Seniors Go Digital curriculum overview
sections.summary: The curriculum covers smartphone applications like Wireless@SG, WhatsApp and Zoom, plus a module on Government Digital Services such as TraceTogether and Singpass mobile.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If I could, perhaps, take a bit of time to just share with the Member and other colleagues an overview of the Seniors Go Digital programme curriculum.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And the applications are, for example, on smartphone features like how to use Wireless@SG, how to use WhatsApp, how to use Zoom.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Then, there is another module specifically on access to Government Digital Services, TraceTogether, Singpass mobile.

sections.label: Health module for seniors
sections.summary: In the health module, seniors are guided on how to use HealthHub and Healthy 365.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: For example, in the health module, the seniors are guided on how to use HealthHub and how to use Healthy 365.

sections.label: Digital and non-digital options
sections.summary: The overall approach is to make the options available and to still make the non-digital avenues open.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Our overall approach is to make the options available and to still make the non-digital avenues open.
